messages.subject: Garrety - revised numbers for sign-off (PRIVILEGED)
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard, Grace,

Birchall Stone have come back asking for: ex-gratia £95k (up from £85k), fees £2,500, 9-month covenants and £5k outplacement. I attach a payment-and-tax breakdown. The total cost to the Company excluding accrued holiday and employer's NIC is £259,830, within the ceiling we discussed. My recommendation is to accept - it's well below our litigation exposure. Please confirm I can agree.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Disputes
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
